fields.ic_name: AMBA AXI / ACE Protocol Specification (ARM IHI 0022E)

encoding.name: Non-shareable
encoding.semantics: Domain contains a single master; no snoop required.

encoding.name: Inner Shareable
encoding.semantics: Inner shareability domain; may include additional masters.

encoding.name: Outer Shareable
encoding.semantics: Outer shareability domain; superset of Inner; may include additional masters.

encoding.name: System
encoding.semantics: All masters in the system; not cacheable.

encoding.name: Normal access
encoding.semantics: Not a barrier.

encoding.name: Memory Barrier
encoding.semantics: Memory barrier — orders memory observation.

encoding.name: Normal access (reserved)
encoding.semantics: Treated as normal access.

encoding.name: Synchronization Barrier
encoding.semantics: Synchronization barrier — orders memory observation AND execution.

tables.name: ARSNOOP — coherent read encodings (Permitted ARBAR[0]+ARDOMAIN+ARSNOOP combinations)

encoding.name: ReadNoSnoop
encoding.semantics: Non-snooping read.

encoding.name: ReadOnce
encoding.semantics: Coherent single-use read; no further coherency commitment.

encoding.name: ReadShared
encoding.semantics: Coherent read; line may be returned as SC/SD or UC/UD.

encoding.name: ReadClean
encoding.semantics: Coherent read; line must NOT be returned dirty (PassDirty must be 0).

encoding.name: ReadNotSharedDirty
encoding.semantics: Coherent read; SharedDirty response not supported.

encoding.name: ReadUnique
encoding.semantics: Coherent read; obtain exclusive copy (invalidate others).

encoding.name: CleanUnique
encoding.semantics: Clean local + invalidate others (no data returned).

encoding.name: MakeUnique
encoding.semantics: Invalidate other caches without returning data (used before full-line write).

encoding.name: CleanShared
encoding.semantics: Cache maintenance: write back dirty + retain Shared copies.

encoding.name: CleanInvalid
encoding.semantics: Cache maintenance: write back dirty + invalidate.

encoding.name: MakeInvalid
encoding.semantics: Cache maintenance: invalidate without writing back.

encoding.name: Barrier
encoding.semantics: Barrier transaction (any ARDOMAIN).

encoding.name: DVM Complete
encoding.semantics: DVM completion message.

encoding.name: DVM Message
encoding.semantics: DVM operation message (TLB inv / BP inv / IC inv / VA sync).

tables.name: AWSNOOP — coherent write encodings (Permitted AWBAR[0]+AWDOMAIN+AWSNOOP combinations)

encoding.name: WriteNoSnoop
encoding.semantics: Non-snooping write.

encoding.name: WriteUnique
encoding.semantics: Coherent partial-line write; other caches invalidated first.

encoding.name: WriteLineUnique
encoding.semantics: Coherent full-cache-line write; ensures uniqueness.

encoding.name: WriteClean
encoding.semantics: Write back dirty line and retain Clean copy.

encoding.name: WriteBack
encoding.semantics: Write back dirty line and invalidate locally.

encoding.name: Evict
encoding.semantics: Notify interconnect of Shareable cache-line removal (no data).

encoding.name: WriteEvict
encoding.semantics: Optional: write back a UniqueClean line for snoop-filter tracking (requires AWUNIQUE).

encoding.name: Barrier
encoding.semantics: Write-side barrier (any AWDOMAIN).

tables.name: RRESP[3:0] read response with IsShared + PassDirty

encoding.name: OKAY UniqueClean
encoding.semantics: Successful read; line installed Unique Clean.

encoding.name: OKAY UniqueDirty
encoding.semantics: Successful read; line installed Unique with PassDirty.

encoding.name: OKAY SharedClean
encoding.semantics: Successful read; line installed Shared Clean.

encoding.name: OKAY SharedDirty
encoding.semantics: Successful read; line installed Shared with PassDirty.

encoding.name: EXOKAY
encoding.semantics: Exclusive access success (only ReadNoSnoop/ReadClean/ReadShared/CleanUnique).

encoding.name: SLVERR
encoding.semantics: Slave error.

encoding.name: DECERR
encoding.semantics: Decode error.

encoding.name: OKAY no data
encoding.semantics: Standard OKAY write response.

encoding.name: OKAY DataTransfer
encoding.semantics: OKAY + DataTransfer (used in WriteUnique/WriteLineUnique pass-dirty completion).

encoding.name: EXOKAY
encoding.semantics: Exclusive access success.

encoding.name: SLVERR
encoding.semantics: Slave error.

encoding.name: DECERR
encoding.semantics: Decode error.

encoding.name: DataTransfer
encoding.semantics: 1 = full cache line of data will follow on CD.

encoding.name: Error
encoding.semantics: 1 = snoop failed.

encoding.name: PassDirty
encoding.semantics: 1 = cache line was dirty; responsibility transferred (line moves Clean or Invalid).

encoding.name: IsShared
encoding.semantics: 1 = snooped cache retains a copy after snoop.

encoding.name: WasUnique
encoding.semantics: 1 = cache line was Unique before this snoop.

encoding.name: UniqueClean
encoding.semantics: Only this cache; matches memory.

encoding.name: UniqueDirty
encoding.semantics: Only this cache; differs from memory; owns write-back.

encoding.name: SharedClean
encoding.semantics: Other caches may hold copy; matches memory.

encoding.name: SharedDirty
encoding.semantics: Other caches may hold copy; differs from memory; owns write-back.

encoding.name: Invalid
encoding.semantics: Line not held in this cache.

encoding.name: ACVALID, ACREADY, ACADDR, ACSNOOP[3:0], ACPROT[2:0]
encoding.semantics: Snoop address channel: interconnect -> cached master.

encoding.name: CRVALID, CRREADY, CRRESP[4:0]
encoding.semantics: Snoop response channel: cached master -> interconnect.

encoding.name: CDVALID, CDREADY, CDDATA, CDLAST
encoding.semantics: Snoop data channel: cached master -> interconnect.

encoding.name: Illegal
encoding.semantics: Must transfer data when passing dirty responsibility.

encoding.name: Illegal
encoding.semantics: ReadUnique requires exclusive ownership.

encoding.name: Illegal
encoding.semantics: CleanInvalid invalidates all copies.

encoding.name: Illegal
encoding.semantics: MakeInvalid invalidates all copies.

axi_baseline_inherited_tables: Table A3-2 Burst size encoding (AxSIZE[2:0] -> 1/2/4/8/16/32/64/128 bytes)
Table A3-3 Burst type encoding (AxBURST[1:0] -> FIXED/INCR/WRAP/Reserved)

evidence.quote: AxDOMAIN[1:0]: 0b00 Non-shareable, 0b01 Inner Shareable, 0b10 Outer Shareable, 0b11 System.
AxBAR encodes barrier transactions on AR and AW channels.
Permitted read address control signal combinations: ARBAR[0]=0 with ARDOMAIN+ARSNOOP encodings for Non-snooping, Coherent, Cache maintenance, Barrier, DVM groups.
Permitted write address control signal combinations: AWBAR[0]=0 with AWDOMAIN+AWSNOOP encodings for Non-snooping, Coherent, Memory update, Barrier groups.
CRRESP[4:0]: [0] DataTransfer, [1] Error, [2] PassDirty, [3] IsShared, [4] WasUnique.
UC UniqueClean. UD UniqueDirty. SC SharedClean. SD SharedDirty. I Invalid.
